summary: Legal developments dominate today, with significant court rulings and regulatory actions impacting various sectors, including pharmaceuticals and legal ethics.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court upheld a case against a pharma firm for substandard Calcium and Vitamin tablets, rejecting the quashing plea.
The Attorney General has granted consent for a contempt of court case against a lawyer for remarks against CJI Surya Kant.
India's food inflation surged to 8.94% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's tolerance limit, raising economic concerns.
US announced further restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips, impacting shares of Samsung Electronics and TSMC.
Geeken Seating Collection aims for ₹3,000 crore revenue by 2030, planning ₹350 crore investment in manufacturing and 200 new stores.
